data.name: Conjure Implement
data.description: You can expend 1 point of inspiration to conjure any item that qualifies as an implement that you know how to use. This implement can be used as the item in question, functioning as a masterwork version of that item. The implement lasts for %1 minutes.|10*InvestigatorLVL
